verdict.rationale: Penpot has no documented sandbox or test-environment feature. An AI-native user can work around this by spinning up a separate self-hosted instance (docker compose or Helm, "in just 3 minutes") or a self-deployed MCP server, then pointing agents at it instead of production. Unlimited teams and files would also allow isolated scratch workspaces, but that is implied rather than documented as a sandbox. Missing for 10: a first-party sandbox/test environment or mode, documented guidance on isolating agent or API testing from production data, seed or test data tooling, and independent corroboration of such a workflow.
